snippet.title: Fall from Space – Trailer II (Game Boy Sci-Fi ARPG)
snippet.description:
A solar system inside a cartridge

Fall from Space is an open-world, non-linear RPG built for real Game Boy hardware and created entirely by a solo developer.

Explore a star system full of secrets, side quests, and choices that matter.

Available soon – www.fallfromspace.com
